leads.name: cizutamig
leads.why_investigate: A clinically tested autoimmune engager and relevant development/competitive benchmark within UCB’s acquired portfolio; not an independently available Candid asset.

identity.basis: Alias is explicit in registry intervention fields; no global engine alias was added.

target_format.basis: UCB explicitly identifies antibody format and targets.

development.basis: SLE/gMG protocols describe Phase 1b, recruiting as last updated 2026-09-02; operational status needs confirmation.

human_evidence.basis: ACR: 47 patients, mean 14-week follow-up; 6 CRS, 3 grade-3 infections, 4 treatment-related serious events. Mixed indications/study routes; not controlled efficacy.

approval.basis: Dated issuer statement, not an exhaustive independent regulator search.

company_relationship.value: UCB announced completed Candid acquisition on 2026-06-17
company_relationship.basis: Release places cizutamig in UCB’s pipeline; September disclosure corroborates continued development. Registry sponsor Candid is not evidence of commercial independence.

territorial_rights.basis: Complete current rights unverified. Historical disclosures identify an EpimAb license outside Greater China (China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan excluded); acquisition alone does not establish a change to that disclosed carve-out. Confirm amendments and change-of-control provisions.

availability.basis: Do not treat as an unacquired independent asset. Any collaboration route requires UCB confirmation.

next_actions: Prioritize UCB portfolio/competitive assessment. Obtain the EpimAb license, regional scope and post-acquisition amendments; confirm any partnering route with UCB.
Obtain indication-specific cohorts, endpoints, follow-up and safety denominators; reconcile registry versus abstract populations and verify current trial status.

limitations: The pooled safety abstract is posted for the November 9, 2026 ACR session, still forthcoming on the observation date. Its 47 treated patients are not the SLE registry’s estimated enrollment of 47.

Nine registry matches: seven autoimmune/immune-mediated disease studies (including thyroid-eye disease), one withdrawn IgE-disease study and one completed healthy-volunteer study. See TRIALS.md; no posted results returned. Registration is not outcome verification.

Follow-up closes specific evidence gaps, not discovery recall or autonomous qualification accuracy. Complete current commercial rights remain unverified; the historical cizutamig territory exclusion is documented. Independent BD usefulness and analyst time remain unmeasured.
